title: Reusable Formatter Function (2 Stages)
description:
Practice building a reusable helper function across 2 stages:
1. Define a function format_badge(title) that returns "[ " + title + " ]".
2. Call print(format_badge("VIP")).
3. Call print(format_badge("PRO")).
